segments.contextBefore: For example, you can use this modifier to know how much of a view is visible on screen.

segments.normalizedSource: ```swift ScrollView(.horizontal) { LazyHStack { ForEach(videos) { video in VideoView(video) } } } struct VideoView: View { var video: VideoModel var body: some View { VideoPlayer(video) .onGeometryChange(for: Bool.self) { proxy in let frame = proxy.frame(in: .scrollView) let bounds = proxy.bounds(of: .scrollView) ?? .zero let intersection = frame.intersection( CGRect(origin: .zero, size: bounds.size)) let visibleHeight = intersection.size.height return (visibleHeight / frame.size.height) > 0.75 } action: { isVisible in video.updateAutoplayingState( isVisible: isVisible) } } } ```
segments.contextBefore: In the following example, the data type you convert to is a `Bool` and the action is called whenever the `Bool` changes.
